parameters.query:
SELECT t.queryid, t.query, t.calls, t.mean_exec_ms,
       monitor.fn_explain(t.query) AS plano,
       monitor.fn_pistas(t.query)  AS pistas
FROM monitor.vw_top_lentas t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM monitor.analises_ia a
  WHERE a.queryid = t.queryid
    AND a.analisado_em > now() - interval '24 hours'
);
